projectDescription: A browser-based daily water intake tracker with quick-log chips, a custom amount slider, a timestamped drink log, and localStorage persistence — no account or server required.
keyFeatures: One-tap quick-log chips for common amounts (4, 8, 12, 16, 24 oz)
Custom amount slider (2–80 oz in 2 oz increments)
localStorage persistence — data survives page reloads without a server
Confetti celebration on every logged drink
Dark mode support via CSS media query
Settings panel with full data reset
Animated intake counter with pop effect
publicApiSurface: localStorage key: water_logged_drinks (JSON array of {amount, time})
logDrink(amount) — internal function: updates total, appends entry, persists to localStorage
saveToLs(name, item) — serializes and writes a value to localStorage
loadfromLs(name) — reads and deserializes a value from localStorage
getFormattedTime() — returns locale-formatted HH:MM time string
renderDrinkUI(amount, time) — appends a drink entry <li> to the DOM list
